fields.label: Working Hours
fields.description: Fallback window, e.g. 09:00-13:00, 14:00-18:00 (used only when no custom slots set).

fields.label: Custom Time Slots (Provider-Wise)
fields.description:
Most-specific override for THIS service+provider. Same format as service-wise:
  - Simple list:  09:00, 10:30, 14:00
  - Per-day list:  MON:09:00,10:00|TUE:09:00,11:00,14:00
Takes precedence over the service-level slots and this provider's working hours.

fields.label: Available Days (per Provider)
fields.description: Comma-separated weekdays this provider can serve: MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT,SUN

fields.label: Days Off (unavailable dates)
fields.description: One ISO date (2026-09-11) per line, or a weekdays token (e.g. FRI) to blacklist that weekday for this provider.
